definition_en: the activity of buying and selling goods and services, a company that does this, matters that need attention, or the thing that is properly someone's concern
core_image: 街角小店开门营业，柜台上放着账本与零钱
scene: 街角的小店从早开到晚，生意一直不错。The little shop on the corner does good business all year.
sceneCN: 这里 business 是「生意；商业」（第 1 个义项：买卖商品与服务的活动）；句意为街角那家小店一年到头生意都不错。

senses.title: Buying and selling
senses.definition: the activity of buying and selling goods or services
senses.definitionCN: 买卖商品或服务的活动
senses.example: The little shop does good business all year.
senses.exampleCN: 那家小店一年到头生意都不错。
senses.why: Business first meant the state of being busy, then the work a person is busy with, and finally trade.
senses.whyCN: business 最初指「忙碌的状态」，接着指一个人忙于做的事，最后指买卖。

senses.title: A company
senses.definition: a company that makes, buys or sells goods or services
senses.definitionCN: 制造、购买或出售商品与服务的公司
senses.example: He runs a small business with his brother.
senses.exampleCN: 他和弟弟一起经营一家小企业。
senses.why: When the buying and selling is set up as an organization, the activity itself becomes the name of the firm.
senses.whyCN: 当买卖被组织成一家机构时，这项活动本身就成了这家公司的名称。

senses.title: Matters to deal with
senses.definition: things that need to be dealt with or discussed
senses.definitionCN: 需要处理或讨论的事情
senses.example: Let us finish the business of the meeting first.
senses.exampleCN: 我们先把会议的事务办完。
senses.why: The old sense of being busy with something survived: any matter that keeps you occupied is your business.
senses.whyCN: 「忙于某事」的旧义保留了下来：任何让你有事可做的事情都叫 business。

senses.title: What properly concerns you
senses.definition: the thing that is properly your concern and not another person's
senses.definitionCN: 本该由你负责、而不是别人的事
senses.example: How I spend my money is my own business.
senses.exampleCN: 我怎么花钱是我自己的事。
senses.why: What a person is busy with is his own concern, so the word also marks the line between my affairs and yours.
senses.whyCN: 一个人忙于的事就是他自己的关切，所以这个词也划出了我的事与你的事之间的界线。

intro.en: Business was formed from busy, and it has moved from the state of being busy to the world of trade.

definition_en: a small device used for doing arithmetic

senses.title: The device for arithmetic

definition_en: a chart showing the days, weeks and months of a year
core_image: 挂在墙上划满格子的纸
scene: 新年第一天她把旧的那本取下来。She marked the date on the new calendar.
sceneCN: 这里 calendar 是「日历」（第 1 个义项：按日月排列的表格）；句意是她在新日历上标出了日期。

derivatives.zh: 历法的，与日历有关的
日程表，语义相关的安排表
时刻表，语义相关

senses.title: The printed chart of days
senses.definition: a sheet or book showing the days and months of a year
senses.definitionCN: 印有全年日月日期的纸页或册子
senses.example: She marked the date on the new calendar.
senses.exampleCN: 她在新日历上标出了日期。
senses.why: The core image is a grid of squares hung on a wall.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象是挂在墙上、由方格组成的纸。

senses.title: A system for dividing the year
senses.definition: a system that fixes the length and order of months and years
senses.definitionCN: 规定月份与年份长短和次序的体系
senses.example: The lunar calendar sets the date of the festival.
senses.exampleCN: 这个节日按阴历定日期。
senses.why: The chart records a system, and the system took the same name.
senses.whyCN: 表格记录着一套体系，体系本身也用了这个词。

senses.title: A list of planned events
senses.definition: a list of dates on which events will happen
senses.definitionCN: 按日期列出活动安排的清单
senses.example: The new term is on the school calendar.
senses.exampleCN: 新学期安排在校历上。
senses.why: A dated chart of days became a dated chart of events.
senses.whyCN: 按日期排列的日历，变成了按日期排列的活动表。

intro.en: Calendar comes from the Latin name for the first day of the month.
intro.cn: calendar 来自拉丁语里表示每月第一天的词。

items.en: calendae named the first day of each month.
items.cn: 拉丁语 calendae 指每月的第一天。

items.en: calendarium was an account book of debts due that day.
items.cn: calendarium 是记录当日到期债务的账簿。

items.en: calendier named a list of dates.
items.cn: 古法语 calendier 指日期表。

items.en: calender named the yearly table of days.
items.cn: 中古英语 calender 指全年日期表。

items.en: Calendar covers the chart, the system and a plan of events.
items.cn: 现代英语中 calendar 兼指日历、历法与日程表。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the calendar base; the near-meaning group gives other planners.
note.cn: 形近组共用 calendar 词基；近义组是其他日程类词。

definition_en: to speak to someone on the phone or to say a name loudly
core_image: 举起手机喊出一个名字
scene: 深夜她想起还有件事没说。She called her mother before bed.
sceneCN: 这里 call 是「打电话」（第 1 个义项：用电话联系某人）；句意是她睡前给母亲打了电话。

derivatives.zh: 打电话的人，来访者
使命，天职；也指呼喊
回想；召回，由 re- 与 call 构成

senses.title: To telephone someone
senses.definition: to speak to someone by phone
senses.definitionCN: 通过电话与某人交谈
senses.example: She called her mother before bed.
senses.exampleCN: 她睡前给母亲打了电话。
senses.why: The core image is raising a phone and calling a name.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象是举起手机，喊出一个名字。

senses.title: To give someone a name
senses.definition: to give a name or title to a person or thing
senses.definitionCN: 给人或事物一个名称或称号
senses.example: They call the dog Lucky.
senses.exampleCN: 他们管这只狗叫 Lucky。
senses.why: To call out a name is also to give that name.
senses.whyCN: 喊出一个名字，也就是给它命名。

senses.title: To shout or cry out
senses.definition: to say something loudly so others hear
senses.definitionCN: 大声说出以便别人听见
senses.example: He called for help from the shore.
senses.exampleCN: 他在岸边呼救。
senses.why: This is the oldest sense, the plain act of crying out.
senses.whyCN: 这是最古老的意思，就是开口大声喊。

senses.title: To visit briefly
senses.definition: to make a short visit to a person or place
senses.definitionCN: 短暂地拜访某人或某地
senses.example: I will call on you tomorrow.
senses.exampleCN: 我明天会去拜访你。
senses.why: Announcing yourself at a door was a kind of call.
senses.whyCN: 在门口报上自己，也算一种喊话。

intro.en: Call comes from Old Norse and replaced an older English verb.
intro.cn: call 来自古诺尔斯语，取代了更早的英语动词。

items.en: kalla meant to cry out or summon.
items.cn: 古诺尔斯语 kalla 意为呼喊或召唤。

items.en: callen took the place of the older verb.
items.cn: 中古英语 callen 取代了更早的动词。

items.en: To call a name also meant to give a name.
items.cn: 十六世纪 call a name 也指给事物命名。

items.en: The telephone added the sense to phone someone.
items.cn: 电话出现后，又添上打电话的意思。

items.en: Call covers shouting, naming, phoning and visiting.
items.cn: 现代英语中 call 兼指呼喊、称呼、打电话与拜访。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the call base; the near-meaning group gives related voice verbs.
note.cn: 形近组共用 call 词基；近义组是相关的发声动词。
